statement: Dolphin models a single MP mediator and an extension port with child-connected bit and copied child identity and calibration. Its emulator has not established two chained MP instances or a second gyro arbiter; synthetic timings and readback cannot be applied to physical Plus plus external MP or nested retail modules.

applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. Dolphin MotionPlus.cpp 95-154, 190-389, 394-465, 600-709 and MotionPlus.h 77-115. #52 not run.
